## Lancaster University

### Senior Teaching Associate, July 2026 to present

I teach statistics and research methods at undergraduate level and on the MSc in Psychology and Behavioural Analytics, and deliver workshops in social psychology. I am a Year 2 and Year 3 Academic Tutor, supervise undergraduate dissertations, act as External Moderator for statistics teaching at Sunway University, and manage the Department's SONA research participation system.

### Teaching Associate, January to May 2024

Designed and delivered lectures and labs for undergraduate qualitative methods, and managed teaching assistants during teaching and marking.

### Teaching Assistant, October 2019 to October 2023

Delivered undergraduate teaching across Psychology modules, including Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Neuropsychology, Personality and Individual Differences, Research Methods, Statistics, R Programming, and Open Science Practices. Led RStudio support sessions for student projects. Over 600 hours of teaching in total.

### Supervision

Supervised three undergraduate research projects (2022–23).

### Guest lectures

-   "Climate Futures Between Collapse and Transformation: Scientists' Discourse and the Politics of Possibility". SGA420 *Navigating Sustainability and Global Environmental Futures*, 2025.
-   "The Psychology of Scientist Activism". PSYCH601, MSc Social Psychology.

## Recognition

-   Associate Fellow of the UK Higher Education Academy (2021), for completion of the Associate Teacher Programme.
